evidence.parentExtractionTest: GET /firearms/ + /firearms/?sort=newest + /firearms/?limit=100 + /firearms/?sort=newest&limit=100 + /firearms/page1.html?sort=newest — ALL 5 variants returned 0 product cards via production SELECTORS (incl .product-element, .productborder, .product-thumb, .product-layout)
evidence.controlExtraction: /ammunition/?limit=100 returned 100 products via .product-element (same selector); /firearms/winchester/ returned 17 via .product-element. Selector logic IS correct — parents are empty by site design.
evidence.siteStructure: Three-tier hierarchy: /firearms/ (TILE-only, 0 products, 57 subcat tiles) → /firearms/{brand-or-type}/ → /firearms/{type}/{action}/. Where children exist as further sub-categories, the parent is tile-only.
evidence.refinedSpineRecommendation: R1's 74-URL list minus 4 zero-yield non-leaf containers (centerfire-rifles, shotguns, rimfire-rifles, combination) PLUS their ~20 sub-action leaves (already partially in R1: lever-action present; bolt-action, break-action, pump-action, semi-auto, falling-block, revolver-action absent).

catalogUrls.dbSpineCoverageRisk: DB's 9-URL spine includes /firearms/ AND /knives/ — BOTH RETURN 0 PRODUCTS at runtime. The DB's categoryStats./firearms/.products: 452 number is stale or comes from a walker mechanism not represented by the URL endpoint itself. The current production crawler reading DB profile would silently miss ALL firearms (~452 products) and ALL knives (~144 products) = ~596 products / 16.7% of catalog.
catalogUrls.r1ListGaps: R1's 74-URL list has 4 confirmed zero-yield non-leaf containers but DOES include /firearms/lever-action/ (29 products) — partial leaf coverage. The 20 sub-action leaves (/firearms/centerfire-rifles/bolt-action/, etc.) are missing.

criticalFinding.title: DB's catalogUrls would silently lose ~596 products (16.7% of catalog)
criticalFinding.magnitude: DB ships /firearms/ + /knives/ as catalogUrls but both return 0 products at runtime via production extractor. Combined with DB's expectedProductCount=3577 and productCountMethod=category-page-walk (silently disabled), the bootstrap/maintain crawlers cannot detect the gap. Promotion of R2 spine + flips IS load-bearing for catalog completeness.

blockers: None for R3. R3 adversarial pass must (a) verify the 20 sub-action leaves actually exist and are non-empty via independent walk, (b) attack the assumption that sitemap 3770 includes all variant/OOS that detail-page verify reaches, (c) dedup R2's 90-URL spine and confirm union vs 3770.
